The plate is about 360 px across. If it is a 26 cm dinner plate, that gives roughly 14 px per cm. The food mound is about 190 px wide, or around 13 cm, and about 130 px tall, or around 9 cm.

The food looks like rice or a grain mixed with diced tomato and onion, with a green salsa or sauce on top. It sits in a low mound, perhaps 2-3 cm high. The footprint is roughly 90 cm², so the volume is around 150-200 cm³. Rice at this looseness has a density near 0.7, which gives about 120-150 g. Adding the sauce, I estimate about 150 g in total.

Cooked rice with vegetables and some oil comes to about 1.4 kcal/g, which is roughly 210 kcal.
